positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: As a member of the Data Science Research lab, I worked on probabilistic knowledge bases, building models for the fusion of multiple knowledge graphs and building a sequence rule mining system for temporal inference over dynamic knowledge graphs. I served as TA in the CISE department,  Mobile Computing, Intro to Data Science, C++ Programming and Operating Systems. I was also the instructor of the Operating System (COP4600) class in summer 2018.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: I worked on Datometry's HyperQ implementing multiple translations and emulations of vendor-specific SQL to be seamlessly used over a variety of cloud databases such as Azure SQL-DW, Redshift, and Snowflake.

positions.title: Intern Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked on an information retrieval project in the Biomedical Domain. I Built a linked data information retrieval system of abstracts from PubMed for interactive faceted browsing that integrated other linked data resources such as UMLS.
